metadata.title: Morse index, nullity and Jacobi fields of homogeneous minimal two-spheres in complex hyperquadrics
metadata.abstract: We determine the Morse index and normal nullity of all linearly full homogeneous minimal two-spheres in complex hyperquadrics. These invariants satisfy a common relation involving only the ambient dimension and the induced Gauss curvature. We also prove that every normal Jacobi field is integrable through minimal immersions.
